models.summary: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's flagship for demanding reasoning, production coding, and long-horizon agent work. On CompareIntel you can run it next to GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and other frontier models on the same prompt to see how it handles your actual tasks—not a vendor demo.

GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's current frontier model for professional workloads: long context, stronger reasoning, and tighter token use on hard jobs. Compare it side by side with Claude and Gemini to judge reliability, writing style, and cost on prompts you actually run.

Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is Google's frontier reasoning model, with a million-token context and multimodal inputs spanning text, images, audio, video, and files. Use CompareIntel to see how it stacks up against Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.5 on coding and analysis.

Claude Sonnet 4.6 is Anthropic's workhorse Sonnet: frontier-level coding and agent performance at a mid-tier price. It is a common pick when you want strong results without jumping to Opus, and it pairs well against GPT-5.4 and faster Gemini models.

DeepSeek V4 Flash is an efficiency-focused Mixture-of-Experts model—284B parameters total with 13B active—plus a 1M-token window and very low per-token prices. It is a strong open-weight option when you want speed and cost control without giving up long context.

Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight reasoning model. It targets long-horizon coding and multimodal work, and it is one of the higher-volume open models on OpenRouter—worth comparing directly with DeepSeek and other open-weight frontier systems.

Grok 4.5 is xAI's high-end model for coding, knowledge work, and STEM, with a 500K-token context and thinking mode. Compare it with GPT-5.5 to see how the two flagships differ on the prompts you actually care about.

GPT-5.4 unifies OpenAI's GPT and Codex lines into one frontier system, with a 1M-token context and vision support. It remains a widely used workhorse next to Sonnet 4.6, and a useful baseline before stepping up to GPT-5.5.
